summary.tldr: Stops regulations and exemptions from allowing supervised drug consumption sites within 500 metres of schools, daycares, or playgrounds.
what_it_does: Adds a rule under the Controlled Drugs and Substances Act that regulations and exemptions cannot allow a site for consuming controlled substances or precursors obtained without authorisation under the Act within 500 metres of an elementary or secondary school, daycare centre, or playground.
Revokes existing exemptions or authorisations, to the extent they apply to a covered site inside that 500 metre zone, when the bill comes into force.

Treats existing exemptions or authorisations for mobile sites as if they include a condition that services must not be provided within 500 metres of an elementary or secondary school, daycare centre, or playground.
summary.background: It adds section 54.2 to the Controlled Drugs and Substances Act.
